verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature, no bulk or full-account export, and no account-exit or offboarding path. The CLI's `--json` output on any command over projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks is a developer building block a user could script into an export. It is not a documented export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
